pkgmetadata.longdescription:
DBGL (DOSBox Game Launcher) is a free frontend for DOSBox and its variants (DOSBox Staging, DOSBox-X, DOSBox ECE) that manages game profiles, per-game DOSBox configurations, screenshots, and metadata lookups.
This package installs Ronald Blankendaal's officially distributed prebuilt Linux release. On arm64, its bundled x86_64 SWT library is replaced with the matching upstream Eclipse Linux aarch64 SWT binary.
DBGL itself does not bundle a DOSBox emulator on Linux; a DOSBox-compatible emulator (games-emulation/dosbox or games-emulation/dosbox-staging) must be installed and configured within DBGL to actually launch games.
